No photo shows shutter count, live view, autofocus test, or any functional check; the seller text is truncated ('No...').

risks.risk: Unverified functionality (shutter, autofocus, buttons, viewfinder, and live view may be faulty even if it looks clean).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, live view, autofocus on a moving subject, and a few shutter clicks with focus confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not guaranteed working; treat as used/untested until proven.

risks.risk: Lens condition issues (haze/fungus/scratches, oil on blades, or focus ring problems) not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of lens glass (front and rear) under light + a short clip taking a photo of a bright window/white wall at f/8 to check haze.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: lens may have optical issues; do not pay premium for 'clean/sharp'.

risks.risk: Battery/charger/accessories not shown (camera may be sold without battery/charger/strap/memory card).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger, strap, cables, memory card if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: camera + lens only (no extras).

risks.risk: Sensor dust or internal problems (common on used DSLRs) not shown.
risks.proof: A photo of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) to reveal dust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: may need cleaning.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the included items (battery, charger, strap, any cables, and memory card if included).
Send a video test: power on → live view → autofocus on a moving object → take 5–10 shots.
Send close-ups of lens front and rear glass under light (and confirm no fungus/haze).
Send a sensor dust test photo (shoot a white wall at a small aperture like f/16).
Confirm shutter count (or show camera info screen with shutter count if available).
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 650D with an 18-55mm kit-style lens, but functionality is not proven; so it should be priced at the worst case (untested/assume issues possible) using the closest DSLR comparables.
